rules: 104/day and 113/day must always appear together. 104 alone is right as a figure and wrong as a conclusion.
The churn lever counts SUBSCRIPTIONS, not payers. Measured payer attrition is 4.75%/mo against the 8.98% the levers use. Comparative use only.
Per-unit lever values must not be summed. They total +5.84%, which is not the +18% package.
The top-20 rungs are a disclosure of what an assumption is worth, not a forecast.
